notes.title: Happy 2nd Bunnyversary!!!
notes.content:
Heya bunbuns!!Happy Second Bunnyversary!! ːpaquerette_happyːːpaquerette_happyːIt’s already been two years????Two years of buns, secrets, bunny secrets……..



It’s been a while (again!!) since the last bit of news here, what are we up to??

Is Bunstack alive???

IS GAME DED?????



The next Into the Bunframe update is in production, lots have happened in our personal lives and working on Bunburrows is still our “sidegig” to make ends meet so huuuuuh it’s coming~ ːopheline_smirkː



Last time, we showed you a glimpse of one of the new hint systems, showed you a bit of Pâquerette’s computer and teased something new [spoiler]glowing in Hell [/spoiler]...


###WELL THERE IS MORE###


But enough of promises, let’s show some of that stuff in action!

=====


Who is that sleepy-looking fellow??



You’ve seen them in the visual for this news, they were even teased back when we released our roadmap, Hèrbe is settling in the shop!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562761/c94e43f9580dcaafbe3ccc7873e4109bb5f2e90e.gif"]



Pâquerette and Ophéline are unsure why Hèrbe is here and what they’re up to… and Hèrbe doesn't look like they know either… but hey Hèrbe is here? I guess??? Congrats?????

Ophéline’s computer rework


Tired of the map being impractical? You can finally see all 5 burrows from there at a glance, with reworked UI and additional info!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562761/1da3f36e166a4e843451309d83c526d781decc06.png"]

This one is still a mock-up and a WIP being integrated into the game!

So don’t look too hard into the levels!!!

They’re not real!!!

The buns are fake as well!!!

It’s not a screenshot!!!



The revamped map is only one of the changes Into the Bunframe is bringing to Ophéline's computer and we still do have a lil surprise.... 


Why is Pâquerette stuck in box???


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562761/90be0c8be37dc24567cd28dca4442887028f3cf6.png"]

I don’t know, you tell me



=====



This is the last stretch for Into The Bunframe since, as you can see, all the features we had teased have now been unveiled~



We hope this year will be kinder to us and will see the release of everything we’ve promised so far.

Sorry for the wait. It is as frustrating for you as it is for us. We swear on every single bunny on Earth.

EVEN ON MOKO. 



Bunburrows is our dearest love project and we are eternally moved by your praise <3

Here is to another year of bunny-catching and meta-breaking~


Happy Bunny Day!!

-Lenophie



Lil bonus: I gave a talk about meta gameplay, the philosophy behind it and implications for the practice of game design as a whole, it's in French but Youtube's auto-generated english captions are good enough! Here it is if you want some brain teases~

Cya!

notes.title: OMG it's been a year! Time for some news and celebration!
notes.content:
Heya bunbuns!

Happy Bunnyversary!!! ːpaquerette_happyː ːpaquerette_happyː ːpaquerette_happyː

One year ago, we released Pâquerette Down the Bunburrows and we didn’t quite expect it would be met with this much enthusiasm from the puzzle community, thank you all so much for all your kind words, fanarts, support, mods, feedback etc!
Bunburrows sold over 20k copies and is now sitting on over 750 overwhelmingly positive reviews (road to 1k??), again, thank you so much~ ːbunnies_loveː

However, we promised some free updates, didn’t we? It's time for a development update, right?

Since releasing the Clockwork Bunnies update back in February and finishing up the Trading Cards in April, we've made good progress on the Into the Bunframe update, the second of the three free updates we announced back in October!
Same as last time, it’s taking its sweet time since we still need to do part-time jobs to make ends meet, plus we’re working on some secret bun stuff in parallel!

This update is focused on extra polishing, quality of life improvements and implementation of hint systems! The idea behind this udpate is to enable as many players as possible to complete the current final objective of the game [spoiler](those three pillars~)[/spoiler] so they're able to experience the amazing stuff we've in store for the final Bunspeakable Depths update when it drops!

Today, we’re presenting you with three of the major additions that will come with Into the Bunframe:

Home capture hint system

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562761/0748c49bb38ed6bbb3159b8af8158617b1cb4fe9.gif

With a single press of a button (Left Stick Press/H), you will be able to see where bunnies are supposed to be captured in each and every level, with a cool lil effect. This effectively helps reduce the possibility space and allows you to confirm the final step from which you can deduce the previous steps! This won’t save you from the clutches of the hardest levels in the game but definitely helps mitigate red herrings and validate theories and guesses. ːopheline_swirlː

Pâquerette’s Computer
Ophéline finally turned on Pâquerette’s Computer and it is filled with helpsies!!!
"It's not as nerdy and ugly as Ophéline's, I can even install games on this one!!" - Pâquerette

Here's a sneak peek of the desktop ːopheline_smirkː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562761/671ef2737df3af9dc5b6133192e0bc217c7df689.png

This always-accessible computer has several features:

 Rules recap: Rules Pâquerette learned are automatically added to a list when Pâquerette solves specific levels. This helps quickly remind players of their knowledge after long breaks and build an overview of everything they know when stuck on a puzzle
 Spoilable rules: When stuck on a level, Pâquerette can spoil herself the mechanics she needs to solve the level, this is purely optional but may be useful when tutorialization wasn't enough for some players. After a confirmation prompt, spoiled rules will be added to the rules recap like any other!
 Dialogues backlog: Pâquerette can re-read every dialogue she had, she likes to laugh at her own jokes.
 A lil surprise~

A new strange light appeared deep down...
What power will it give this time?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562761/2b58b62295ffac3feefedf2281c3d0f1d60fc0f8.gif

These three changes are only a part of all the goodies that are coming with Into the Bunframe! More news as we get closer to the update release~

Happy Bunny Day!!
- Lenophie

notes.title: Clockwork Bunnies Update is Here!!!
notes.content:
Heya bunnies!
Clockwork Bunnies is here!!

This is the first of the 3 updates we teased in our Roadmap (don't look at the dates uwu)

In short:

 A new secret bunny late mechanic was introduced (go experiment!)
 Reworked the bunny counter so releasing bunnies feels less like losing progress
 New [spoiler]void bunny[/spoiler] somewhere in the [spoiler]NW?[/spoiler] bunburrow
 Lots of visual polish~
 LOTS and LOTS of bugfixes, particularly those very nasty lagsplosions

Hope you will have a blast with this while we're cooking the main piece~
Community items are almost ready, only wallpapers are left before everything can go live!
Work on the Into The Bunframe and Bunspeakable Depths updates has been ongoing alongside Clockwork Bunnies, more on that soon!
To celebrate, we're running a -20% discount for the whole week~

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562761/4eda6ec5e5b9f73f89d5107e38bbaae7eb68174c.jpg

Full changelog:
 Added new secret mechanic [spoiler]Bunny Bumps[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]This is our answer to nondeterministic bunsplosions, cases where it was unclear which block should get bunsploded.[/spoiler]
 The mechanic will be fully exploited in the Bunspeakable Depths update, in the meantime, you may find use for it to make new babies???
 Bunny counters and signs no longer decrease when undoing captures or releasing bunnies so you don’t feel like losing progression anymore. Instead, the bunny icon is briefly replaced with a pen icon indicating how many bunnies are in the pen when appropriate.
 [spoiler]Hell[/spoiler] levels now have some new visual flavor based on the bunburrow they are below of, go give them a looksie!
 Ghostly Bunburrow’s tileset was improved and some mushrooms even started growing there~
 Pâquerette and Ophéline sprites improved
 Counters are displayed below bunnies when stacking at least 7 of them
 Cursed tiles now have proper visuals on the map
 Timer should now be more consistant
 Timer now changes color when paused
 Change in speed multipliers
 x1.3 -> x1.25 inside tunnels
 X1.15 -> x1.2 when chasing carrots
 Fix "lagsplosions": Instances where (intentionally or not) making the game lag would result in unpredictable/inconsistent behaviour
 This required the introduction of a tick management system, implied a refactor of a huge chunk of the bunnies’ logic
 It was intensively tested but if you find any behaviour that’s inconsistent with what you were used to, babies that are no longer possible or new trivial solutions to existing puzzles, please tell us!
 Fix "speedsplosions": Instances where modified the bunnies’ speed while in movement would result in unpredictable/inconsistent behaviour
 This has only be documented to happen in this update’s beta but I wouldn’t be surprised if this had been here all along
 Bunnies’ speed modification is now either applied immediately if the bunnies aren’t moving or when all bunnies finished their current movement.

 Added a new [spoiler]void bunny[/spoiler] somewhere in the [spoiler]NW?[/spoiler] bunburrow
 Secret “Infinite Speed” mode was removed as it was no longer maintainable with the new tick system
 Fix “magic walks”: Instances where bunnies would inadvertently change direction and never stop moving, even through walls, if a bunsplosion happened somewhere in the level during their own carrot chase
 Fix bunny seeing diagonal traps when inside tunnel
 Fix bunnies incorrectly prioritising the wrong traps when surrounded by traps under very specific conditions
 Fix bunnies not [spoiler]stacking[/spoiler] under certain circumstances upon entering a level from the side
 Fix bunnies not getting stuck in traps when spawning on them after falling in holes or trespassing
 Fix dialogues being missable when quitting the game while they’re still being displayed
 Fix bunny not respawning upon re-entering their level under certain circumstances (bunny sent down hole then trespass)
 Fix hovered bunny info not being displayed upon closing and re-opening map
 Fix Paquerette being able to move when falling on a hole
 Fix cases where bunnies would move after a trespass without being prompted by Paquerette and without being in a deadend
 Fix some tiling issues next to bunny pillars
 Fix bunny shakes being unaffected by speed
 Fix carrots not reappearing after a reset when a hole was dug on their spawn position
 Fix color of the dialogue box in the [spoiler]temple[/spoiler] biome
 Fix "Should Capture Bun" dialogue triggering in W-1 if you reset after capturing
 Fix [spoiler]Hell Temple and Golden[/spoiler] bunnies unlocking Ophéline’s [spoiler]temple[/spoiler] bunny dialogue
 Fix bunny not chasing carrots when it is laid on the tile right behind them while they’re in a deadend
 Fix bunny not shaking during some trespassing and falling scenarios
 Fix C-13 teleport skipping (when entering Forgotten Bunburrow early) by quitting the game
 Fix resetting through pause menu while entering hole allowing for some weird teleportation
 Fix cheese in S-12

 Fix typos
 Levels previously visitable only thanks to lagsplosions were removed from the map: [spoiler]NW?-19, NE?-17, NE?-18, NE?-19, SE?-18, SE?-20, SE?-21[/spoiler]

notes.title: Roadmap update!!
notes.content:
Heya bun-buns,
As you may have noticed, we're a bit late on the schedule announced in the roadmap, we're very sorry about this.
But fret not, progress has been made:

 Community items announced for November are almost done (emojis, badges and cards are ready, only the wallpapers are left~)
 Clockwork Bunnies update has been the end of me (hi, Lenophie typing!), it is a difficult refactor with a lot of trial and error, I haven't managed to fix the indeterministic bugs in a way I find adequate: I do have a fix that works but would force me to enforce a specific FPS cap instead of letting you pick yours in the options, I still have ideas on how to go about this but it's time-consuming and let's be honest, not very motivating compared to making new content, I'm still committed to delivering this but claiming I could do that soon was an oversight.
 Work on the Into the Bunframe update has started in parallel! 

To be fully transparent, while Bunburrows did sell well, it didn't sell well enough for us to dedicate ourselves full time to making new free content, we still have part-time jobs so we can make ends meet and have savings for our next productions (!), which is perfectly fine but does explain why we're taking a bit long~
Two of us are also struggling with mental health issues, the arrival of winter isn't particularly helping either, please bear with us!
We're still committed on providing all that we announced in the roadmap (for free, except for the one paid DLC ofc), just expect a delay on the announced dates~


We're also very glad to have you all enjoy this little silly bunny game! With your consent, we're going to add some cute fanarts you all made of the game in each of our minor news such as this one!

Look at this firey bun by EndMark_3 !!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562761/d1467326202b702c407e612561459e5d1050b864.png

More news soon!!
Happy bun-catching!
- Lenophie

notes.title: "When will you add X???" Roadmap time!!
notes.content:
Heya!
It's been a while, right??

First of all, thank you all again for your amazing welcome, we're so glad you enjoyed the game this much and that so many of you are already waiting for the extra content we teased despite how DIFFICULT it is to get to that point~

It's about time we give you our plans for what's next!

Behold the Bunburrows Roadmap!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562761/23ff20ff57e31c746ff724b9ba7c9ff568df8249.png

Here are the plans for our upcoming free updates!

 Clockwork Bunnies Update is being actively worked on, beta testers are having a go at it, the update will be pushed to everyone when I'm done fixing everything~
 Into the Bunframe Update is a bunch of Quality of Life features that have been requested since release (improved computer, map, baby hint system, rules recap, dialogues history, improved home captures feedback...), it also lays the foundation for the main piece:
 The Bunspeakable Depths Update will finally complete Bunburrows' end-game, giving you access to a whole new area below the infamous Pillars Room, surprises are still waiting much deeper~ More details later... It will release at the same time as a paid lil DLC about another kind of expedition down the bunburrows...
 Official Modding Support is also coming 👀 Our Discord community has already managed to make their own mods, even custom level packs with their own level editor! However, *official* modding support with Workshop integration will have to wait for all our own content to be out before being considered!

Mac version is still being worked on, just some undecipherable bugs along the way, bear with us... The build is already working on Macs with the M1 chip but not on other older models *yet*!

Steam Trading Cards are coming in November~

Also,
THE BUNBURROWS OST IS AVAILABLE EVERYWHERE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562761/e543b3afc06f17bb3dde5df96ab1181649ec20ff.png

Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL2ZkPXypFRNCyr9qhH5RYbXuRokTHI4f0 
Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/intl-fr/album/1nNKnRfBK4RBrEUFTDzJrb?si=Pdai9gXzTUCbi3bckAk7qw 
Deezer: https://www.deezer.com/fr/album/473446605 
ITunes: http://itunes.apple.com/album/id1701470482?ls=1&app=itunes 

Go blast them bangers on full volume!!

FAQ:
"Why no precise date for the Clockwork Bunnies update?"
Can't give a precise date because it's really a trial-and-error process requiring lots of code rewriting! I'm making weekly progress but it's complicated, I didn't expect to have to make rhythm-game-core tick-based code for a bunny-catching game but heh, meta game happened and the implications got out of my hands hehe

"Will Clockwork Bunnies have new content?"
Clockwork Bunnies won't feature new levels, however some changes to bunny behaviour in very specifc cornercases + the new meta mechanic may mean new opportunities for babies! It will also feature some cool new visual polish!

"But at the end of the game, it said 'in a few weeks' for the new content, why take so long?"
It's all on me (Lenophie), not the rest of Bunstack. I added this line in the last days leading up to release without really putting that much thought into it, but the sheer scope of what we have planned meant for us to take several months rather than a few weeks, however it will *really* be worth it ;)

"omg you talked about mods, i want mods NOW!"
Head to our Discord while you wait for official support ;)

Feel free to ask any other questions you may have in the comments~

That's it, bun-buns!
Hope you're as excited as we are uwu
'til next time!!
- Lenophie

notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
Heya bunbuns!
Here is the 1.0.9 Update!!!!

Changelog:

 Fixed cheese in [spoiler]W-21[/spoiler]
 Fixed cheese in [spoiler]S-16[/spoiler]
 Fixed Home Capture cheese in [spoiler]N-22[/spoiler]
 Fixed [spoiler]pilgrimage[/spoiler] cheese
 Fixed pathfinding bugs when navigating around multiple holes and hole+deadend combos: The bunny will now properly prioritize holes in the traditional setup: front over left over right, bunny will no longer pick hole over deadend as it was erroneously the case under some circumstances
 Fixed [spoiler]Bunbel Tower[/spoiler] achievement not requiring a bunny from the Forgotten Bunburrow as part of the [spoiler]stack[/spoiler] requirement
 Fixed secret SFX for first [spoiler]%!!/.;\[/spoiler] captured playing on multiple captures under certain circumstances
 Fixed Ophéline dialogues being missable by resetting from the pause menu during her dialogues. Missed dialogues related to progression are available again for affected players.
 Fixed resetting and [spoiler]going back to surface[/spoiler] being available in the pause menu during dialogues
 Fixed carrot sound being triggered when a bunny reaches a tile with an already eaten carrot under some circumstances
 Fixed typos in french localization
 Fixed style of Infinite Speed option
 Fixed visual glitch showing unnecessary corners on indestructible walls next to [spoiler]bunny pillars[/spoiler]
 Fixed some [spoiler]bunny pillars[/spoiler]'s eyes being erroneously turned on or off in some levels
 Added some cool tunnels around some [spoiler]bunny pillars[/spoiler], showcasing their own pilgrimage
 Added a few new [spoiler]bunny pillars[/spoiler] here and there: the Gate remains shut, yet more bunnies are coming, is this only the beginning?


Consequences:
No changes will be made to your save, but please take a new look at [spoiler]N-22[/spoiler] if you're stuck on [spoiler]N-19[/spoiler]!

Please note, we are still aware of the 2 following issues:

 one that the community dubed "lagsplosions" that allows capture of babies that are not capturable in other ways through lag
 one regarding bun stacks being undeterministic about their spawn position during wall bursts

I wanted to fix them in this update but they require quite the amount of work and focus while being less critical than some of the stuff fixed here!
Once these will be fixed, we'll be able to bring all the QoL stuff you have been asking about (baby hint system, never-decreasing bunny counter, more accessibility settings, improved timer features, dedicated map button etc etc)
We're also working on [spoiler]a Mac version[/spoiler], more on that soon!

Hope you will enjoy this!
This update has been extensively tested but if you have find *new* pathfinding bugs introduced today, please let me know!

Friendly reminder to leave a positive review to the game if you enjoy it <3 We're over halfway to 500 reviews and its Overwhelmingly Positive rating!!

Happy bun-catching!
- Lenophie

notes.title: Demo QoL Update (31/05/22)
notes.content:
Heya bunnies!
Today we're updating the demo with the latest Quality of Life improvements we worked on for the full game! Hope you'll like those!

Inputs

Prevent dialogue skipping with movement keys
	
	Sometimes players would inadvertedly skip dialogues while intending to move
	The trap-laying key (Space/A) is now the exclusive way to progress through dialogues
	
Added input buffering
	
	Trap interactions or move direction changes didn't register when Pâquerette was still moving
	The game now buffers your inputs during movement and apply the adequate ones when Pâquerette is done moving
	
Improved move direction changes
	
	The game would ignore a movement input if the previous one was still being held
	The game now correctly prioritizes movement inputs based on held duration
	
Prevent movement when undoing
	
	This didn't break the game but resulted in weird visual jitter
	
Added a tutorial for the Undo mechanic
	
	The mechanic was already there but the tutorial didn't advertise it, congrats to those who had already discovered it :B
	
Added a catch-up tutorial for the Reset and Undo mechanics
	
	When a player got the right solution to the level L-5 on their first attempt, they wouldn't get the Reset tutorial
	Thus added a forced tutorial in L-6 in case it was missed
	

UI/Localization

Added names to the levels (!!)
Added blinking to item counters at the beginning of levels
Support for special characters
	
	Special characters such as "à", "é" or "ç" from the french localization are now correctly displayed.
	
Improved wording of some tutorials
Dialogues now always progress by 2 lines at once (they sometimes only did by one, which was kinda confusing)

Audio

Increased time taken by musics to progress to their calm version (30 seconds -> 75 seconds).

Levels

Minor changes to L-9 "R_bbit"

Bugfixes

Fixed missing exclamation mark from when bunnies are chased
Fixed a broken dialogue trigger in Level L-3 "Priority"
Fixed exclamation mark position when bunnies are [spoiler]stacked[/spoiler]
Fixed incorrect dialogue box background color when triggering a dialogue at the very start of a level with a different visual theme


Feel free to give us your feedback on these changes in the comments~
(Particularly, please tell me about how much better the controls feel now~~)

Buh-bye!
- Lenophie
